The technical documentation states that a physically implausible jump in one channel while others stay stable suggests a sensor fault; no such jump is observed in the provided data.

The absence of recent maintenance records is a gap but does not constitute direct evidence of a sensor problem. Consequently, while a data-quality issue cannot be ruled out entirely, the available evidence leans against it, yielding low confidence.
